kind: Independent review finding after raw-database-FD amendment
finding: A fork child inherits a per-journal RLock that may be held by a parent thread which no longer exists in that child; public methods acquire it before PID guards

reproduction.environment: Actual macOS local journal and controlled os.fork while one parent helper thread holds journal._mutex
reproduction.cleanup: Only the test-owned child process was terminated after its bounded timeout; parent thread released and journal closed normally
reproduction.recording_qualification: Transcribed actual tool observations; source was inspected and hashed before the probe, without a separate before/after recorder

required_amendment: Reset each journal object's mutex to a new threading.RLock in _after_fork, in addition to resetting the global driver registry mutex; add a bounded multithreaded-fork negative-authority regression
